This folder contains Windows binaries from:

- zapret / winws — https://github.com/bol-van/zapret  (MIT)
- zapret-win-bundle — https://github.com/bol-van/zapret-win-bundle
- WinDivert — https://github.com/basil00/Divert  (LGPLv3)

They are used only as a local DPI bypass on the machine that runs Network Optimizer.
Do not redistribute this folder separately without the original licenses.
